read_contract.description: Read one UTF-8 text chunk using only path, start_byte and max_tokens as input fields. Only path is required; both other fields may be omitted. The range includes the starting byte and excludes the stopping byte computed by the tool; the caller supplies no ending position. Read to EOF when the remaining text fits the token budget. Otherwise the result supplies a continuation cursor. An EOF cursor returns empty text; a missing file fails.
read_contract.name: read_file

max_tokens.description: Optional; omitted means 4096. Integer returned-text token budget from 256 through 8192 inclusive, not a byte or line limit.

path.description: Required string: file path relative to the workspace root.

start_byte.description: Optional; omitted means 0. Integer inclusive UTF-8 byte offset, into decoded text, from 0 through its UTF-8 byte length, including EOF. Must be on a UTF-8 character boundary.

observation_token_accounting: whole ModelEvent JSON; actual wire excludes audit-only fields via to_model_dict, so see actual_input_text for exact injected shape
